P01.rationale: A client photo is present in the right column but it shows two people at moderate size, not a single dominant founder portrait filling a major portion of the page.

P05.rationale: The Frese Recruiting client photo is clearly framed and named at a reasonable size in the right column, roughly a quarter of the column, though it shows two people rather than a single named individual portrait.

P07.rationale: There is no press/logo wall, rating cards, review grid, or multi-source testimonial apparatus; only a single pull-quote is present.

P10.rationale: A large opening quotation mark glyph appears before the testimonial block, but there are no giant ghost numerals or other oversized decorative typographic elements.

P11.rationale: Three bold metric callouts (reaction time, conversations, headcount) are present as text-based before/after stats but there are no charts, graphs, or visual data representations.

P12.rationale: The layout is reasonably well-filled with a two-column structure, body text, metric callouts, and a testimonial, though the lower-right area feels somewhat sparse compared to magazine-density references.

P13.rationale: A very subtle off-white/cream paper texture is present in the background, providing minimal atmospheric quality rather than a strong intentional texture.

P14.rationale: The client photo has a dark background that naturally provides contrast, and no text is overlaid directly on the photo, so readability is maintained without a formal scrim treatment.

P16.rationale: No device or product mockup (phone, laptop, book) appears anywhere on the page.

N07.rationale: The photo appears to be a real business photo of actual clients holding an award, which reads as specific rather than generic stock imagery.

N08.rationale: The lower portion of the right column below the testimonial is noticeably empty, creating a dead-space gap, though the rest of the page is adequately filled.

N10.rationale: No text is placed directly over a busy photo; the image and text occupy separate, clearly delineated zones.
